source: CRAN SoyNAM 1.6.2, quality-assured soybase data; GPL-3; cite dataset authors
feature_cutoff: 30 days after planting; no height, flowering, maturity, moisture, lodging, seed-size, yield/protein/oil/fiber outcomes or plot/row IDs as predictors
features: Known experimental family/strain, site, year and planting calendar information only initially; include weather only if matched pre-cutoff data are actually collected and verified
split_rule: Choose calendar years by sorted distinct source years before inspecting outcomes: all but last two years train, penultimate year validation, last year untouched test. Need at least three years or stop. Keep all plots for environment-year together. Report distinct environment counts.
selection: Validation environment-macro MAE only per target, refit training+validation only after selection, then test once. Keep all scores and baseline comparisons. Fit transforms only on training.
scope: Experimental SoyNAM maturity groups late II to early IV in measured US trials. Neither arbitrary commercial seed nor all North America is validated. R8 maturity is a physiological stage, not a learned optimal harvest day. Protein/oil are composition factors, not premium grade probability. Moisture/protein reference basis must be reported unknown if source does not specify it.
product_rule: Only saved artifacts with source hashes, units, exact feature schema, held-out errors and domain guards may serve. Surface research domain, unavailable features and data-only limitations in product. No synthetic samples, CPU neural fallback or paid source.
